verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a professional legal-services firm, not a software or data-hosting product, so letting a user choose a data storage region is a category error for this kind of product. Its Privacy practice advises clients on GDPR, CCPA and other data protection laws, but that is legal counsel, not a residency feature it ships. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm offers a data-hosting capability that would make this axis apply.
